modifier_targets.label: Armor Cast Penalty
modifier_targets.description: The armor penalty on casting (casting/core.json), in percent of itself: -50 halves it.

modifier_targets.label: Attack, Lone Foe
modifier_targets.description: Points on the attack target while only one foe engages the actor.

modifier_targets.label: Attack, Ally Engaged
modifier_targets.description: Points on the attack target against a foe an ally also engages.

modifier_targets.label: Ally Attack Aura
modifier_targets.description: Points on the attack target of allies who can see the actor.

modifier_targets.label: Barter Prices
modifier_targets.description: Percent better prices when buying and selling.

modifier_targets.label: Beastfolk
modifier_targets.description: The actor is beastfolk, a kin of the beastfolk template.

modifier_targets.label: Block Magic
modifier_targets.description: A block also stops a spell of any damage type, at half shield DR (docs/core/combat.md).

modifier_targets.label: Block Share
modifier_targets.description: Percent more damage a block takes off.

modifier_targets.label: Blue Magic Duration
modifier_targets.description: Percent longer duration of the actor's Blue Magic.

modifier_targets.label: Bulwark
modifier_targets.description: A critical block negates the hit (docs/core/combat.md).

modifier_targets.label: Charm Resistant
modifier_targets.description: The actor resists charm and mind-affecting magic.

modifier_targets.label: Cleave on Kill
modifier_targets.description: A melee blow that drops a foe carries on to one more within reach.

modifier_targets.label: Crafted Quality
modifier_targets.description: Quality grades added to what the actor crafts.

modifier_targets.label: Creation Perks
modifier_targets.description: Extra perks taken at character creation.

modifier_targets.label: Crit Damage
modifier_targets.description: Percent more damage on a critical hit.

modifier_targets.label: Crit Window
modifier_targets.description: Points added to the actor's crit window (resolution/core.json), on every check.

modifier_targets.label: Damage Below Half HP
modifier_targets.description: Percent more damage while the actor is below half HP.

modifier_targets.label: Darkvision
modifier_targets.description: The actor sees in darkness, out to its darkvision range.

modifier_targets.label: Darkvision Range
modifier_targets.description: How far darkvision reaches. The data holds metres here, not units (M5-33).

modifier_targets.label: Detection Chance
modifier_targets.description: Percent change to the chance of being detected while sneaking; negative is harder to detect.

modifier_targets.label: Disease Resistance
modifier_targets.description: Percent less taken from disease.

modifier_targets.label: Dispel Level
modifier_targets.description: Spell levels added to what the actor's dispels can end.

modifier_targets.label: Dodge Stamina
modifier_targets.description: Percent change to the stamina a dodge costs; negative is cheaper.

modifier_targets.label: Fence Prices
modifier_targets.description: Percent better prices when fencing stolen goods.

modifier_targets.label: Frighten on Crit
modifier_targets.description: A critical hit by the actor frightens the foe.

modifier_targets.label: Fearless
modifier_targets.description: The actor cannot be frightened.

modifier_targets.label: Generating Multiplier
modifier_targets.description: Added to the generating cycle's magnitude multiplier (wuxing/core.json) for the actor.

modifier_targets.label: Green Magic Magnitude
modifier_targets.description: Percent more magnitude of the actor's Green Magic.

modifier_targets.label: Gun Crit Window
modifier_targets.description: Points added to the crit window of the actor's attacks with guns.

modifier_targets.label: Heavy Armor Surcharge
modifier_targets.description: Percent change to the stamina and AP surcharges heavy armor adds; negative is cheaper.

modifier_targets.label: No Heavy Charge Surcharge
modifier_targets.description: Power attacks and charges in heavy armor cost no heavy surcharge.

modifier_targets.label: Hostile Parley
modifier_targets.description: The actor may parley with hostile foes.

modifier_targets.label: HP per Level
modifier_targets.description: Hit points added to the actor's maximum per level.

modifier_targets.label: Ignore Armor DR
modifier_targets.description: Points of armor DR the actor's blows ignore.

modifier_targets.label: Ignore Spell Resist
modifier_targets.description: Points of resist the actor's spells ignore.

modifier_targets.label: Indigo Magic Range
modifier_targets.description: Percent more range of the actor's Indigo Magic.

modifier_targets.label: Scent Detection
modifier_targets.description: Points on detection checks that rely on scent.

modifier_targets.label: Lands on Feet
modifier_targets.description: The actor always lands on its feet.

modifier_targets.label: Languages
modifier_targets.description: Languages the actor knows beyond its own.

modifier_targets.label: Last Stand
modifier_targets.description: Once per rest, a blow that would drop the actor leaves it at 1 HP.

modifier_targets.label: Loot Roll
modifier_targets.description: Added to every loot roll the actor makes (docs/core/loot.md).

modifier_targets.label: Sleepless
modifier_targets.description: The actor cannot be put to sleep by magic.

modifier_targets.label: Mana Cost
modifier_targets.description: Percent change to the mana a spell costs the actor; negative is cheaper.

modifier_targets.label: Medicine Healing
modifier_targets.description: Percent more healing from the actor's mundane medicine.

modifier_targets.label: No Medium Armor Surcharge
modifier_targets.description: Medium armor adds no stamina or AP surcharge to moving and dodging.

modifier_targets.label: Melee Damage
modifier_targets.description: Percent more melee damage.

modifier_targets.label: Mental Resist
modifier_targets.description: Points on checks against charm, fear, and sleep.

modifier_targets.label: MP Regeneration
modifier_targets.description: Percent faster MP regeneration.

modifier_targets.label: Natural Weapon
modifier_targets.description: The actor has a natural weapon; the feature's description gives its dice.

modifier_targets.label: Piercing Crit Window
modifier_targets.description: Points added to the crit window of the actor's piercing attacks.

modifier_targets.label: Poison Resistance
modifier_targets.description: Percent less taken from poison.

modifier_targets.label: Potion Magnitude
modifier_targets.description: Percent more magnitude of the potions the actor brews.

modifier_targets.label: Light Armor Proficiency
modifier_targets.description: The actor is proficient with light armor.

modifier_targets.label: Medium Armor Proficiency
modifier_targets.description: The actor is proficient with medium armor.

modifier_targets.label: Ranged Crit Window
modifier_targets.description: Points added to the crit window of the actor's ranged attacks.

modifier_targets.label: Range Penalty
modifier_targets.description: Percent change to the actor's range penalties; negative is smaller.

modifier_targets.label: Red Magic Magnitude
modifier_targets.description: Percent more magnitude of the actor's Red Magic.

modifier_targets.label: Reload Cost
modifier_targets.description: AP added to the cost of reloading; reloading has no action row yet.

modifier_targets.label: Rerolls per Rest
modifier_targets.description: Checks per rest the actor may roll again, keeping the second roll.

modifier_targets.label: Rest MP
modifier_targets.description: Percent more MP recovered when resting.

modifier_targets.label: Riposte
modifier_targets.description: A critical evade of a single attack lets the actor attack back at no AP cost (docs/core/combat.md).

modifier_targets.label: Safe Fall
modifier_targets.description: How far the actor falls without damage. The data holds metres here, not units (M5-33).

modifier_targets.label: Second Wind
modifier_targets.description: Once per rest, falling below half HP heals the actor by its second wind HP.

modifier_targets.label: Second Wind HP
modifier_targets.description: Hit points a second wind heals.

modifier_targets.label: Shield DR
modifier_targets.description: Points added to the damage a block subtracts (docs/core/combat.md).

modifier_targets.label: Skill Points per Level
modifier_targets.description: Skill points added at each level-up.

modifier_targets.label: Sneak Attack Crit
modifier_targets.description: The actor's sneak attacks always crit.

modifier_targets.label: Sneak Attack Damage
modifier_targets.description: Percent more damage on a sneak attack.

modifier_targets.label: Speed
modifier_targets.description: Units per round added to the actor's walking speed.

modifier_targets.label: Unstaggerable
modifier_targets.description: The actor cannot be staggered.

modifier_targets.label: Stealth in Darkness
modifier_targets.description: Points on stealth while in dim light or darkness.

modifier_targets.label: Summon Duration
modifier_targets.description: Percent longer duration of the actor's summons.

modifier_targets.label: Sunlight Sensitive
modifier_targets.description: The actor is hindered on checks in bright sunlight; the feature's description says how.

modifier_targets.label: Unsurprisable
modifier_targets.description: The actor cannot be surprised.

modifier_targets.label: Swap Cost
modifier_targets.description: AP added to the cost of swapping weapons; swapping has no action row yet.

modifier_targets.label: Tag Skills
modifier_targets.description: Tag skills added at character creation.

modifier_targets.label: Thrall Limit
modifier_targets.description: Thralls added to how many the actor can hold.

modifier_targets.label: Thrown Damage
modifier_targets.description: Points of damage added to the actor's thrown weapons.

modifier_targets.label: Trap Detection
modifier_targets.description: Points on checks to detect traps.

modifier_targets.label: Unarmed Damage
modifier_targets.description: Points of damage added to the actor's unarmed strikes.

modifier_targets.label: Unarmed Damage Share
modifier_targets.description: Percent more unarmed damage.

modifier_targets.label: White Magic Magnitude
modifier_targets.description: Percent more magnitude of the actor's White Magic.

modifier_targets.label: Woodland Stride
modifier_targets.description: Difficult terrain of plants and undergrowth costs the actor no extra movement.

modifier_targets.label: Yellow Magic Duration
modifier_targets.description: Percent longer duration of the actor's Yellow Magic.
